SimplifiedChinese.format: Custom Float 在帧中存在 Word 0 时将其拆分为 uint16、uint8 和 8 个 bit 通道；更短的帧直接输出已匹配部分，帧尾前的后续 Word 各自沿用 JustFloat 输出一个 float 通道。
SimplifiedChinese.example:
unsigned char frame[12] = {0x34, 0x12, 0x56, 0xA5, 0x00, 0x00, 0x20, 0x40, 0x00, 0x00, 0x80, 0x7F};
write((char *)frame, sizeof(frame)); // 后续 Word 为 2.5f

TraditionalChinese.format: Custom Float 在幀中存在 Word 0 時將其拆分為 uint16、uint8 和 8 個 bit 通道；更短的幀直接輸出已匹配部分，幀尾前的後續 Word 各自沿用 JustFloat 輸出一個 float 通道。
TraditionalChinese.example:
unsigned char frame[12] = {0x34, 0x12, 0x56, 0xA5, 0x00, 0x00, 0x20, 0x40, 0x00, 0x00, 0x80, 0x7F};
write((char *)frame, sizeof(frame)); // 後續 Word 為 2.5f

English.format: Custom Float splits Word 0 into uint16, uint8, and eight bit channels when that Word is present. Shorter frames emit only matched data; every later Word before the frame tail retains JustFloat behavior and emits one float channel.
English.example:
unsigned char frame[12] = {0x34, 0x12, 0x56, 0xA5, 0x00, 0x00, 0x20, 0x40, 0x00, 0x00, 0x80, 0x7F};
write((char *)frame, sizeof(frame)); // later Word is 2.5f
